preconditions.description: The number of missiles N is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.
The arrival time t_i of each missile is between 0 and 100000, inclusive.
The frequency f_i of each missile is between 0 and 100000, inclusive.
The arrival times of the missiles are non-decreasing.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimum number of hackerX missiles needed to defend Nation B.
